verdict.rationale: Grok is itself an agent/assistant (chat + Grok Build coding agent), and the MCP-related evidence (grok-docs-2,3,19,38) describes Grok acting as an MCP *client* connecting outbound to a user's custom MCP server — not Grok exposing itself as an MCP server for other agents to connect to. Per the rules, client-side MCP connectivity does not make this server-role axis applicable, and there is no evidence of a first-party 'Grok as MCP server' endpoint.
